newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish govt shake-up expected over judge delisting.
newsitem.headline: Irish govt shake-up expected over judge delisting.

text.p: Justice Minister Nora Owen is expected to announce further major changes to her Department in parliament later on Wednesday, when a special debate opens on the report of the inquiry into the delisting of a judge.

The inquiry was ordered after 17 prisoners had to be released and immediately re-arrested, because a judge in the Special Criminal Court was not told until November that the Cabinet had removed him from that court on August 1 last.
The Government has already announced that the running of the prisons and the courts are to be taken away from the Department.
The inquiry has labelled as "quite inexcusable" the failure of Department officials to notify Judge Dominic Lynch of the decision to remove him.
The inquiry was also unable to find out why no action was taken after the Attorney General, Dermot Gleeson, wrote to the Department on October 1, questioning the status of the judge.
